Authoritative, audited figures.

Operating income (loss) by segment is summarized below:.

|   | Year Ended December 31, |   |   |   |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| (In thousands) | 2016 | 2015 | $ Change | % Change |
| North America | $408,424 | $460,961 | $(52,537) | (11.4)% |

| Asia-Pacific | 68,338 | 36,358 | 31,980 | 88.0 |
| Latin America | (33,891) | (30,593) | (3,298) | 10.8 |
| Connected Fitness | (36,820) | (61,301) | 24,481 | 39.9 |
| Total operating income | $417,471 | $408,547 | $8,924 | 2.2% |

The increase in total operating income was driven by the following: 2022 operating income in our north america operating segment decreased $ 52.5 million to $ 408.4 million in 2016 from $ 461.0 million in 2015 primarily due to decreases in gross margin discussed above in the consolidated results of operations and $ 17.0 million in expenses related to the liquidation of the sports authority, comprised of $ 15.2 million in bad debt expense and $ 1.8 million of in-store fixture impairment. This increase was offset by investments in our direct-to-consumer business and entry into new territories.
